title: Know what the selection could not reach
statement: As a developer, I can see every change the test selection could not connect to a story, so a short list of tests never reads as proof that the rest is safe.
overview: Proposed addition, and the one this selection cannot do without. On v0.6.0 to v0.7.0, 1,378 of 17,802 changed lines reach a story, so a list built from the rest would look reassuring and be wrong.

acceptance_criteria.statement: `release tests` lists changed lines that reach no story, with a count, every time.
It also lists affected stories with no catalog entry, and criteria with none.
It exits 3 when anything is listed and 0 only when the recorded links reach all of it, as `review test-plan` does.
The output says a complete list reflects only recorded links, and never says it is safe to skip the full suite.
A fix with no story appears here as unmapped change, and its release can still go out.
